senses.gloss:
Kaivacchala(kavivatsala)
a descriptive name of Hāla, compiler of Gāthāsaptaśatī. See Saptaśatī I. 3.

Kaivartasiṃha
son of Lakṣmaṇasiṁha; ancestor of Rūpanārāyaṇa (a. of Rūpanārāyaṇīya Mahādānapaddhati, IO. 1715; ms. d. 1530 A. D.).
See also Kane, HDS. I. p. 602a.

Kaivalāśī_(?)
Bik. 1672.

Kaivalya
(Kaivalyopaniṣad ?) Kaḍayanallūr 74.

Kaivalyakandalī
by Nīlakaṇṭha Tīrthapāda of Kerala (born in 1871 A. D.).
See Contribution of Kerala to Skt. Lit. p. 266.

Kaivalyakalpadruma
name of C. by Gaṅgādhara Sarasvatī on his own Svārājyasiddhi; composed in 1826 A. D.
Pt.. Benares, 1896.

Kaivalyakalpalatikā
bhakti. by Mādhava Sudhī. Trav. Uni. 10004.

Kaivalyakavaca
Taylor II. 144.

Kaivalyakālikātantra
SK. Ray 210 cha A. SK. Ray D.. 126 (Paṭala 2).
--C. Ṣaṭcakravivṛti by Viśvanātha on ch. II of the work which agrees with ch. 6 of Pūrṇānanda's Śrītattvacintāmaṇi. L. 429. RASB. VIII. A. 6368.
Pt.. (1) Tantrik Texts, Vol. II, p.. 109-39. Calcutta, 1913. (2) a. end [Page077-b] of A. Avalon's The Serpent Power, p.. 96-128. 6th edn. Madras, 1958.

Kaivalyagāthā
IM. 4110 (inc.).

Kaivalyagāthā
metrical summary of Vaiṣṇava vedānta in 18 chs.; by Kṛṣṇānanda Sarasvatī, disciple of Saccidānanda of Kaivalyadhāma.
Pt.. with Saṅgatisūtra. Benares, 1903. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 320.

Kaivalyajñānodaya
compiled from Śivapurāṇa.
Pt.. with Gujarati explanation, Surat, 1918. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1209.

Kaivalyatantra
tantra. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 29 (upto Paṭala 5). Ani. Dacca D. R. 65 (Paṭalas 1-5). Gough p. 37. L. 265. RASB. VIII. A. 6009. 6010 (5 Paṭalas). Vaṅgīya p. 31 (5 Paṭalas). Varendra 455.
Q. in Śaktiratnākara, Oxf. 101b.

Kaivalyatīrtha
teacher of Anubhavānanda (a. of Kośaratnaprakāśa an. C. Prabhāmaṇḍala on Śāstradīpikā).
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 207a.

Kaivalyadīpa(-pikā)
adv. metrical adaptation of Tamil work Kaivalyanavanīta. by Kṛṣṇa, pupil of Kṛṣṇayatīndra an. Brahmānandayati. Adyar II. p. 144b. Adyar D. IX. 790. 791 (inc.).
--C. Prabhā by a. himself. Adyar D. IX. 792. 793 (inc.).
Pt.. Skt. an. Tamil versions (1) Kumbhakonam, 1933 (inc.). (2) Palghat, 1940. A. mentioned here a. Śaṅkukavi.
See NCC. IV. p.. 293b an. 372a.

Kaivalyadīpikā
name of C. by Hemādri on Bhāgavatamuktāphala of Vopadeva.
Pt.. Cal. Ori. Ser. 5, Calcutta, 1920. [Page078-a.

Kaivalyadīpikā
adv. in 4 chs. by Bodhānanda. MT. 2934 (with C.). Tekkemaṭham IV. 119A.
--C. Sneha by Nārāyaṇapriyayati alias Durgāprasādayati, student of Rāmatīrtha. MT. 2934. Tekkemaṭham I. 94A. 94B.

Kaivalyadīpikātaila
by Appayācārya (died in 1901 A. D.).
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 261a.

Kaivalyanavanīta
adv.
See Kaivalyadīpa(-pikā) by Kṛṣṇa (Śaṅkukavi).

Kaivalyanavanīta
by Vidyānandanātha.
Pt.. with Telugu C. Madras, 1889. in Telugu script. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1897, p. 38a.

Kaivalyanirūpaṇa
viś. adv. criticising the view of Pillai Lokācārya on Kaivalya. by Varadadeśikācārya, son of Veṅkaṭācārya of Vādhūlagotra. Adyar II. p. 156b. Adyar D. X. 194.

Kaivalyanirṇaya
MT. 3745 (b).

Kaivalyapāda
4th pāda of Patañjali's Yogasūtras. Dacca 4504.
See Yogasūtras.

Kaivalyaprāptyaṣṭaka
by Vibhavarāma Śarman. IM. 8873.

Kaivalyabrāhmaṇa
Q. in the Bhagavannāmamāhātmyasaṅgraha of Raghunāthendra Yati. on the greatness of Śatarudrīya hymns p.. 11-12. Princess of Wales Sar. Bha. Texts. 56.
This is Kai. Up. II. 24.

Kaivalyamohanakavaca
from Rudrayāmala. Trav. Uni. 4771.
C.. Kaivalyakavaca.

Kaivalyaratna
adv. a compilation based on Upapurāṇas an. forming a supplement to [Page078-b] a.'s earlier work Advaitaprakāśaka based on Śruti, Smṛti, Itihāsa an. Mahāpurāṇas. by Vāsudevajñānamuni. Lucknow Mus. MT. 3628 (a.. NP. V. 102. 178. RASB. V. 3866. SB. 395.
Pt.. Pandit N. S. 5, 6, Benares, 1876, 1901.

Kaivalyaratnasubhāṣitapadavyākhyāna
--C. on words found in the extracts from the Parāśara Upapurāṇa given in Kaivalyaratna noted above. MT. 3628 (c). 7134.

Kaivalyarahasyopaniṣadādi_(?)
collection of Up.. Naḍuvil Maṭham 31.

Kaivalyavardhanī
name of C. on Saundaryalaharī by Akhaṇḍānanda.
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 17a.

Kaivalyavallīpariṇaya
allegorical philosophical drama by Rāmasvāmi Śāstrin of Ilattūr in Travancore (C. 1823 A. D.).
See V. Raghavan, ‘Skt. Lit. 1700-1900’, J. of Madras Uni. XXVIII. ii. p. 182.

Kaivalyavallīpariṇayavilāsa
kāvya. a narrative version of the above (?) IO. 8133.

Kaivalyavicāra
Prativādibhayaṅkar p. 6, no. 38.

Kaivalyavivaraṇa
--Vidvatsannyāsapaddhati from. PUL. I. p. 101.

Kaivalyaśataka
101 verses on Viṣṇu by Nīlakaṇṭha Gosvāmin.
Pt.. Bankura, 1923. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 693.

Kaivalyaśatadūṣaṇī
viś. adv. criticism of Vedāntadeśika's view, in favour of Pillai Lokācārya. by Śrīnivāsa of Bhūtapurī (Sriperumbudur); called Śrīśaila Lakṣmaṇamuni or Rāmānujamuni in his Saṁnyāsa life. Adyar II. p. 156b. [Page079-a. Adyar D. X. 195. Prativādibhayaṅkar p. 11, no. 24 (a..).

Kaivalyaśākuna
śakuna. (Pāśaka Kevalī) (Bhagavadbhāṣita) ascribed to Garga. Jodhpur 1828.

Kaivalyasādhana
adv. Mysore I. p. 459 (2 mss.).

Kaivalyasāra
metrical exposition of Vīraśaivism. in 12 cantos by Mari To1ṇṭad-Ārya.
Pt.. with Marathi transl. Vīraśaivaliṅgi-brāhmaṇa-dharma granthamālā 2, Sholapur, 1907. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 626.

Kaivalyasiddhyudayavimarśastotra
by Avadhūta Muni. TCD. 1127C (4 Vimarśas only). Trav. Uni. C. 1881C.

Kaivalyasopāna
BISM. v.. 275/7.

Kaivalyasaudhaniḥśreṇikā
vedānta. Hz. 1127, p. 112. 1221, p. 119. Oppert II. 7535.

Kaivalyastotra
Jodiya II. 33.

Kaivalyasthāna
adv. MT. 193 (g).

Kaivalyasthānanirṇaya
viś. adv. on the venue of Kaivalya, viz. Vaikuṇṭha beyond Virajā river. composed in Kali 4082. by Sudarśanavarapradaguru. MT. 3671 (c).

Kaivalyānandatīrtha
disciple of Mahādevatīrtha.
--Praṇavārthaprakāśikā. adv. TD. 7758.
--C. on the same. Burnell 95b. TD. 7619.

Kaivalyānandatīrtha
--C. on Mahimnasstava. Oudh V. 6.

Kaivalyānanda(yogīndra)
teacher of Svayamprakāśayati (a. of C. Rasābhivyañjikā on Advaitamakaranda of Lakṣmīdhara; see NCC. I. Revised edn. p.. 130b, 131a; Ātmānātmaviveka, see NCC. II. p.. 61b, 62a; C. on Dakṣināmūrtistotra, MT. 7401; C. on Hari(mīḍe)stotra of Śaṅkara, MT. 1265 (b). TA. 3645). [Page079-b]

Kaivalyānanda_Sarasvatī
--Bhagavadgītāsāra. Hall p. 121. NW. 290.

Kaivalyārṇavavivarta
--Gurusahasranāmastotra from. Dacca 176. L.

Kaivalyārthāvabodha
Taylor II. 196.

Kaivalyāśrama
pupil of Govindāśrama.
--C. Saubhāgyavardhinī on Saundaryalaharī.
Pt.. Saundaryalaharī, Ganesh & C.. p.. 1-68. Madras, 1957.
--(Tripurā) Varivasyārahasya. tantra. Bik. 1367. Viśvabhāratī 1899.
--Sundarīṭīkā. Luck. Uni. p. 40. Same a. his C. on Saundaryalaharī ?.
--Sundarīvidhi. IM. 5395 (inc.). On the mode of worship with Saundaryalaharī ?.

Kaivalyāśramin
--Mahāvākyavivaraṇa. adv. Otherwise called Vedāntasārapañcīkaraṇa; on the 12 Mahāvākyas. TD. 7565-6.

Kaivalyāṣṭaka
a.. refrain harernAmaiva kevalam |
Pt.. Stotraratnāvalī, p.. 278-80. Gītā Press, Gorakhpur.

Kaivalyāṣṭaka
by Upaniṣadbrahmendrayogin alias Rāmacandrendra. MT. 4209 (f). Up. Br. Mutt 49.

Kaivalyendrasarasvatī
preceptor of Jñānendra Sarasvatī, preceptor of Abhinava Nārāyaṇendra Sarasvatī (a. of C. on Śaṅkara's Chāndogyopaniṣadbhāṣya, MT. 1662 an. Ait. Up. Bhāṣya, RASB. II. 214).
